specializations.label: Path Reader
specializations.description: Notice routes and danger early, then keep moving when the ground turns bad.

specializations.label: Steady Hand
specializations.description: Endure pressure, handle physical work, and improvise away from the settlement.

specializations.label: Field Eye
specializations.description: Read living terrain carefully and bring back useful food or materials.

sceneSequence.title: A Call Across the Square
sceneSequence.body: A storehouse tally has gone wrong. Voices rise in the square, but no Pokémon is to blame; people are deciding who will carry the burden.

choices.step_into_square: Step forward and hear the request
choices.hang_back_and_listen: Stay back and listen before stepping in

outcomes.released: The argument settles enough for the steward to speak plainly. You are free to choose whether to help.
outcomes.listened_first: You let the sharpest voices reveal who is angry with whom before the steward catches your eye. You enter the request with that context in mind.

sceneSequence.title: The Steward's Errand
sceneSequence.body: A small route must be checked before supplies move. The problem began with people and weather, not a convenient monster to defeat.

choices.accept_errand: Accept the route-checking errand as asked
choices.set_terms: Agree, but ask what matters most before you leave

outcomes.entrusted: The steward marks you as entrusted with the route. That relationship will remain part of the run.
outcomes.terms_set: You accept on clear terms: report hazards first, and do not risk yourself for a perfect map. The steward remembers that boundary.

sceneSequence.title: A Promise at the Mill
sceneSequence.body: The millkeeper asks for an account when you return. It is not a faction banner yet—just a local person who will remember what you said.

choices.promise_return: Promise to return with an honest account
choices.decline_promise: Say you will report if you can, but make no promise

outcomes.promise_recorded: The promise is remembered. Your next step is to leave Reedbank and test the old levee route.
outcomes.no_promise: The millkeeper is disappointed but accepts the answer. You leave without owing a personal promise, and that distance is remembered.

sceneSequence.title: Beyond the Last Dry Marker
sceneSequence.body: You leave the settlement with limited provisions. The old levee is exposed, narrow, and more valuable than it looks because every safe crossing matters.

choices.take_old_levee: Spend a provision and leave for the old levee now
choices.wait_for_ferry: Wait for the ferryman and keep your provisions

outcomes.levee_reached: One provision is spent. You reach the old levee and begin reading the living terrain around it.
outcomes.ferry_delay: You keep your provisions by waiting for a crossing, but lose time before reaching the old levee.

sceneSequence.title: Weedle at the Crossing
sceneSequence.body: Weedle signs cross the route. You can simply give the colony space or risk a careful read of the tracks and feeding pattern.

choices.give_space: Give the colony space and pass quietly
choices.read_signs: Read the signs closely (Sense + Tracking check)

outcomes.observed: You make direct contact with the ecology without forcing a bond. The route remains open.
outcomes.setback: The signs are misread and pressure builds, but the encounter is still recorded without turning Weedle into an enemy token.
outcomes.partial: You understand enough to pass, though the crossing costs time and attention.
outcomes.full: You read the route cleanly and learn how the colony is using the levee.
outcomes.exceptional: The pattern is unusually clear; you gain an extra ecological insight without recruiting a companion.

sceneSequence.title: The Windbreak Boundary
sceneSequence.body: The fastest line cuts through a useful windbreak. Beedrill activity and Rattata trails matter, but so does the orchard keeper's need to protect the boundary.

choices.protect_windbreak: Respect the windbreak and take the careful route
choices.take_shortcut: Take the shortcut and accept the social cost

outcomes.windbreak_protected: You protect the windbreak, record the Beedrill and Rattata interactions, and keep the keeper's trust.
outcomes.shortcut_taken: You make faster ground, but the keeper remembers the strained choice. The Pokémon ecology was only part of the problem.

sceneSequence.title: Return to Reedbank
sceneSequence.body: You turn back with a route account, relationship consequences, survival cost, and direct Pokémon observations. A companion was never required.

choices.return_with_account: Return to Reedbank and finish the run

outcomes.ending_ready: The first slice is complete. The 0/3 companion route is a valid ending, and the accumulated state remains saved.
